newsitem.title: USA: Pinnacle Systems sees Q2 operating loss.
newsitem.headline: Pinnacle Systems sees Q2 operating loss.

text.p: Pinnacle Systems Inc said Thursday it expects to post a pre-tax operating loss between $7.5 and $8.0 million in its second quarter ending December 27 on revenues that will range from $5.0 to $6.0 million.
The expected operating loss includes at least $4.0 million in one-time charges, the company said in a statement.

Leading to the operating loss is lower-than-expected demand across all its product lines with the most significant impact being a reduction in desktop original equipment manufacturer (OEM) business, Pinnacle said.
